admission.justification: The shared line, its authority copy, the recovery detail and the size budget must agree, so one statement keeps every seat told the same way to declare a wait.

applicability: The always-on wait line that every role capsule receives via core/every-role.md and its authority/recovery references.
conditions: The line is composed from core/every-role.md (backed by AU10.3 in core/authority.md) into every role capsule.
exclusions: Role-specific wait rules, which live in their own texts.

evidence: sync-skills --check; capsule budget tests; packet v8 named core/invariants.md, but the line's source is core/authority.md

statement: The always-on wait line in core/every-role.md tells every seat, on any harness, how to declare a helper wait (WAITING FOR SUBAGENTS:) or a background wait (WAITING FOR BACKGROUND:, naming process, id/log, expected end, check in 1-30 min, default 3), that a harness wake continues its own work, and sends no progress role_message; its canonical authority is AU10.3 in core/authority.md, and recovery counts either declared wait as a wait.
title: Always-on wait line defines helper and background wait markers uniformly
